# PlateVault

> PlateVault (https://www.platevault.app) is a free community archive for license plate spotting and car spotting in Europe. Members upload photos of number plates, tag the car brand, model and generation, and browse a searchable database by country, brand and model.

## What it is
- A plate spotting / platespotting / carspotting community and number plate database, similar in spirit to PlatesMania.
- Country archives with accurate plate rendering (Germany incl. seasonal, electric, oldtimer, red, diplomatic, military and state plates; Austria; Czechia; Croatia; Bulgaria; Albania; Belgium; Bosnia).
- Interactive region maps (districts, Bezirke, regions) showing where plates were spotted.
- Multi Spots: the same plate spotted by several members; vehicle statistics count each plate once.
- Vehicle catalog by brand, model and generation; transport company directory; weekly challenges; leaderboard; quiz.
- Free to use, no ads.
